fields.label: Cell #
fields.description: Please provide your cell # so we can reach out if we need any clarification.

fields.label: Forwards
fields.description: Rank up to 16 forwards. Rank 1 = best. Rank only players you have an opinion on; blanks are fine. Stats in each list update automatically as games are played.

fields.label: Defense
fields.description: Rank up to 10 defensemen. Rank 1 = best. Ranks 9 and 10 are optional.

fields.label: Goaltenders
fields.description: Rank up to 3 goaltenders. Rank 1 = best.

fields.label: Important Notes
fields.description: Injuries, position changes, or players you would take with an asterisk. Anything the directors should know before the final roster is set.

confirmations.name: Default Confirmation
confirmations.message: Thank you for submitting your ballot. If you have any changes, please text Jamie Callery at 978-873-0774.
